info.title: estimate_storage_cost
info.description: Monthly Azure cost for the client's storage inventory (dbo.storage): file shares (Azure Files Premium / Azure NetApp Files), managed/PaaS database volumes (SQL MI, Hyperscale, PostgreSQL/MySQL Flexible Server, Oracle), and object storage (Blob). Classifies each volume from its type + target_service, applies a USD/GB-month rate from live retail prices and the firm's estimation_config.json, and returns a line-item bill with a low/expected/high range. Block / managed-disk volumes are EXCLUDED here (priced by estimate_compute_cost) unless config.storage.price_block_from_storage_table is set.

post.summary: Monthly Azure storage cost for the dbo.storage inventory
post.description: Pass every row from dbo.storage (storage_id, server_id, type, size_gb, iops, target_service). Returns per-volume line items, a by_type breakdown (file / db / object), totals with a low/expected/high range, the block volumes it excluded (to avoid double-counting the per-VM managed disk in estimate_compute_cost), and caveats. Quote region + price_date and the DB-storage caveat.

200.description: Line-item storage cost with totals and a low/expected/high range
